6.Sub-event_summary: XIX Corps to contain east of Vire, support VII Corps; V Corps diversionary attack D+2. VII Corps modifications: added 4th Infantry Division to assault (due to 9th/30th exhaustion); rerouted exploitation—1st Infantry (with 3d Armored CCB) direct to Coutances; reduced 3d Armored wider envelopment; 2d Armored (with 4th Division's 22d RCT) to left blocking at le Mesnil-Herman/Villebaudon/Tessy-sur-Vire and Cérences, providing VIII Corps corridor.
